description: Sends a traveller's first message to a home's host through CielStay: questions, dates and party, a request to book, or a monthly or long-stay inquiry. Free. guestEmail must be the traveller's own address: CielStay emails it a confirmation link, and the message goes on only after the traveller opens it and signs in or creates a free account. Available for homes that carry messageHostUrl: hostReach in the reply is "host" (the host manages the home on CielStay) or "possible_contact" (a contact published on the operator's own site is told a guest asked; they may not answer). For any other home it is refused with hostReach "none", and bookUrl is the way to the host. CielStay never takes bookings or payments; the host replies with their terms. Takes the id from search_vacation_rentals or get_listing_details. messageHostUrl is the same form for the traveller to send.

guestEmail.description: The traveller's own email address, which receives the confirmation link

message.description: The message to the host, in the traveller's words: who is coming, why, and any questions

name: contact_host
title: Message the host
